[11.16-11.20 | Phonics, Lesson #/Title] Heggerty - Week 14Magnetic Foundational Skills - Unit 3 Sessions 4-5
[11.16-11.20 | Phonics, Wednesday (Session 4), Learning Target] Today I will read and write words with the long i sound, recognize contractions, and read Spring to Spring fluently with expression.
[11.16-11.20 | Phonics, Wednesday (Session 4), Success Criteria] read the super words also, been, look, good, most, too, very, and who.
[11.16-11.20 | Reading, Vocabulary & Strategy] Vocabulary & Strategy: ecosystems, habitat, survive, desert, dunes, canyons, cactus, spines, shelter, shady, valley, burrowing
[11.16-11.20 | Grammar, Vocabulary & Strategy] Vocabulary & Strategy: adjectives, commas, shades of meaning, verbs
[11.16-11.20 | Grammar, Standards (Thursday)] Distinguish shades of meaning among verbs that differ in manner (e.g., look, peek, glance, stare, glare, scowl)
[11.16-11.20 | Grammar, Thursday (Session 5), Learning Target] Today I will identify verbs and explain how they are similar and different.
[11.16-11.20 | Writing, Tuesday, I do] Review the words survive and adaptation.
[11.16-11.20 | Math, Monday Session 1, Learning Target] read the time on a clock to the nearest 5 minutes.
[11.16-11.20 | Math, Monday Session 1, Learning Target] figure out whether a time should be AM or PM.
[11.16-11.20 | SS, Lesson #/Title] Unit 2: Our Georgia (Georgia’s geographic features review)
[11.16-11.20 | SS, CER Exit Ticket, Wednesday] Where does the Chattahoochee River begin?
[S.S. 8.17 - 8.21 | Vocabulary & Strategy] Vocabulary & Strategy: government, rules, laws
